يشتوي (form VIII)
# يَشْتَوِي (yaštawī) /jaʃ.ta.wiː/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
# يَشْتَوِيَ (yaštawiya) /jaʃ.ta.wi.ja/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
